### ① Derived judgments

The face is the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration alone: no `packages/spec/src/**` file and no governed path in the diff. What widens: `@object-ui/components` exports `PageHeaderPhoneContext` and the type `PageHeaderPhoneFace` (a host slot, never metadata: no `page:header` key reads it), and `PageHeaderActionsProps` gains an optional `face: 'row' | 'bar'` whose default `row` is the old behaviour. What retires is `MobileViewSwitcherContext`, an app-shell file that was never on the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry, so no public name narrows. No authored metadata key, stored shape, i18n key or server path moves; the phone reads the spec's own `deriveRecordSurface(def, { viewport: 'mobile' })`.

### ② Semver level

patch for both packages, as the changeset declares: one new export pair and one optional prop; a host that provides no phone context draws the header's action row exactly as before (pinned by the control case in `page-header-phone-bar-27058`), and every behaviour change is gated below 768 px.

### ③ Boundary flags

On a phone the record page mounts no `RecordPageDrawerHost` and the list mounts no `ObjectViewRecordOverlay`; a `?recordId=` link is replaced (not pushed) by the record route, with `?recordId=` stripped from the page's origin. The bar face queues the host's Edit after the page's own actions, so it folds into `⋯` when two authored actions fill the bar; the host's Delete stays in the destructive band. Scroll memory is an in-module map keyed by history entry, bounded at 50, and stops restoring at the reader's first touch or wheel or after 3 s. `navigation-overlay.tsx` and `recordDrawerStack.tsx` are not edited.

## 席位核对

1. **Shape:** 32 files (+2069 / −353), `Fixes #27058`: below 768 px the record is always a page (`deriveRecordSurface(def, { viewport: 'mobile' })`; no pane, no drawer stack, `?recordId=` replaced by the record route); one view switcher (the #27594 title leads the list toolbar row; `AppHeader`'s dropdown and `MobileViewSwitcherContext` retire); the phone top bar 「‹ 对象列表」 / 「‹ 父记录名」 with `n / N` ↓ ↑; the header subtitle from the first two declared text highlights plus at most four highlights; the bottom action bar (`PageHeaderPhoneContext`, the header's `PageHeaderActions` in its `bar` face, portaled); related rows and lookups pushed as pages with the path row and scroll restore. Inside claim 6547925555 as amended by 6548379901; the file surface beyond it is named in the PR body (the context file beside `page-header-trailing-context.ts`, comment-only lines, pins in `plugin-detail` / `plugin-grid`). `packages/spec` untouched. Not governed, 2422 lines ≤ 3000 (`check-governed-merges --pr 28477`).
2. **Contract:** `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (`PageHeaderPhoneContext` + `PageHeaderPhoneFace` exported, optional `PageHeaderActionsProps.face`; the retired context was never on a package entry); TIER_DEFAULT review record by this seat, PASS on this head (6549952200; the first record 6549766372 was on `15455616ba`, before the two CI fixes).
3. **Preview gate (ruling 6520722066):** the seat read the 13 app-crm shots at 390 × 844 in `08421f1c82` against `RecordMobile.dc.html` at `a7825499aa` (three frames: list · record page · one level down), through the card's Targets. Matches: the list's title switcher 「全部线索 ▾ · 5」 in the toolbar row and no second dropdown (`01`); the record page's one way back with `5 / 5` ↓ ↑, name + object chip, highlights in two columns, the stage bar, the tab row, the < 760 stack, then 动态 (`02`, `04`); the bottom bar [Convert Lead][编辑][⋯] that stays at the bottom edge while the body scrolls (`03`, `y 779 + h 65 = 844`); one level down with the path row 「线索 Marie Curie › 客户 Acme Corp › 商机」 and 「‹ Acme Corp」, `1 / 3` over the parent's related rows (`07`), and ‹ returning to the scroll position it left (`08` 315 → 315, `09` 212 → 212); the enlarged related tab with the child's card rows (`11`); the bar's ⋯ with 删除 in its own band (`12`); the subtitle from declared text highlights (`13`, rig-patched metadata). Differences, accepted below or owed as follow-ups (item 6).
4. **Gates (check-runs on this head):** 55 runs, 44 success, 11 skipped by path, 0 other; `Test UI` 16/16, `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Check Changeset` success. The first head `15455616ba` was red on `Build & E2E UI` (the record-header width source scan lost the toolbar's row class literal) and `Type Check UI` (an existing test lacked the new `phone` argument); `af3acee1f7` fixes both, and the dev reproduced each red on the old file and proved the new pin with an ablation. The dev's battery: 31 new tests plus moved pins (#27524, #27594, #26896, #27950, #13114) updated not deleted; ablations (the phone signal off: every phone case red, every control green; four held together: 10 red; the ‹ label: 3 red), each restored; `dispatch-gates --commands` 34/34, 0 NOT MEASURED.
5. **Deviations accepted:** no avatar initials (hotcrm#1199 ruling A); the bar is the page column's last flex row rather than `position: fixed` + `scroll-pb` (same reading: visible while scrolling, body ends at the bar); the ‹ of a page one level down is named by its parent record (seat reading of Target 3 vs 8); the push shown as lead → account → opportunity (app-crm has no task object); the host's Edit queues after the page's authored actions in the bar; the counter has no group scope (as #27524 ④, #28461).
6. **Follow-ups owed by this seat (filed after this lands):** (a) the phone record page keeps `AppHeader` above the record's top bar, so the page has two bars where the board has one, and the app bar's mobile label repeats the record name the header draws directly below (Target 3: 「the record name … is not repeated」; the label is `main`'s, not this PR's); where the app menu, search, notifications and account go on a phone record page is a product question, put to the maintainer on that card. (b) The phone list's card rows (`01`) draw every shown column as a label / value line, where Target 2 and the board's list frame have the name, one subtitle line from the first two shown columns and one status chip (`plugin-grid`, outside this card's surface); the enlarged related tab's cards (`11`) sit inset from the body width.
7. **Changeset, read sentence by sentence:** patch for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/components`; each paragraph is true against the diff.
